evals.prompt: /durable-workflow-runtime demo_prompt_loop implement a menu item, then start the workflow without creating any files in the repo root
evals.expected_output: The agent allocates the start request and response under .durable-workflow-runtime/host-io/ by using scripts/host_io.py before calling bridge.py start.

evals.prompt: Resume the current durable workflow run after a yielded step; preserve run_id and step_id and store the observation safely
evals.expected_output: The agent uses scripts/host_io.py observation-path and response-path for run-scoped files, then calls bridge.py resume with matching run_id and observation.run_id.

evals.prompt: Debug why bridge.py start fails when I pass /tmp/start-request.json as the request file
evals.expected_output: The agent explains that bridge.py rejects normal host I/O outside .durable-workflow-runtime/host-io/ and only recommends --allow-unsafe-host-io-paths for explicit transport debugging.
